subject.title: feat(workboard): add durable status_changed notification event

question: Should Workboard formally support `status_changed` as a durable, replayable subscription event for downstream consumers, rather than leaving status-transition consumption to polling or consumer-specific behavior?
rationale: This is a new long-lived plugin notification and stored-data contract, so code correctness alone cannot decide whether its API scope and maintenance commitment are desired.

options.title: Sponsor the durable event
options.body: Confirm `status_changed` as a supported Workboard subscription kind after real persisted-runtime proof is added.

options.title: Keep consumers on existing terminal events
options.body: Decline the new durable transition contract and close this direction rather than expanding the Workboard API.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the durable event
recommendation.body: Confirm `status_changed` as a supported Workboard subscription kind after real persisted-runtime proof is added.

likelyOwner.reason: The branch author is the only identified contact for the proposed Workboard contract; current-main ownership history could not be collected in this read-only environment.
